candidates.name: decrease_collider_penalty_high
candidates.hypothesis: Reducing the high penalties for collision will encourage agents to drive more closely without excessive contact.
candidates.rationale: This change aims to balance aggression and safety, allowing for overtaking while minimizing penalty-driven stagnation.

candidates.name: increase_overtake_bonus
candidates.hypothesis: Increasing the bonus for clean overtakes will promote more aggressive but safe passing behavior.
candidates.rationale: Promoting clean overtakes can enhance competitive dynamics and overall progress in races.

candidates.name: reduce_hook_contact_penalty
candidates.hypothesis: Lowering the penalty for hook contact will help minimize drastic setbacks associated with minor contact.
candidates.rationale: This will foster more competitive interactions by allowing slight contacts without severe penalties.
